QUOTE: `mbedtls_memory_buffer_alloc_init(buf, len)` (`memory_buffer_alloc.c:566`) carves allocations out of a caller-supplied static buffer. It calls `mbedtls_platform_set_calloc_free()` to install `buffer_alloc_calloc_mutexed`/`_free_mutexed`, or the unmutexed pair if threading is off.
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer says the buffer allocator's init function installs itself via the setter, but it never says this is the only in-tree user of the setter. It also doesn't name MBEDTLS_MEMORY_BUFFER_ALLOC_C.
